test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five friends, Hiba, Suhani, Pritam, Ahmed, and Rosy are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Rosy is second to the right of Pritam, and is an immediate neighbour to both Suhani and Ahmed. If Ahmed is second to the left of Pritam, where is Hiba seated?

options.text: To the immediate left of Suhani
Second to the left of Suhani
Third to the left of Suhani
Second to the right of Suhani

solution:
**Given:**

Five friends, Hiba, Suhani, Pritam, Ahmed, and Rosy are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Solution:**

(1. ) Rosy is second to the right of pritam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/699b358b1bf8b9c3f6435a71bf45b3f7b9f26fbfa5455d1e91eca79738e3f331.png] 

(2.) Ahmed is second to the left of Pritam,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af21d08184ae071cb0a3152f8e3ef9de08d38f0c252c1c4715e3f76dcb599a2a.png] 

(3.) Rosy is second to the right of Pritam, and is an immediate neighbour to both Suhani and Ahmed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dba9091ce1df1f2b3dca7ae13f0c0be60f30f0ac1ff4fe6d2440fa44bd7336a8.png] 

(4.) Now , Hiba sits on only vacant seat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b264adbd6bdafa3ae6521d1a4a2a6a2539856ac23c2b35fb89a74920c450659f.png] 

Thus, Hiba is seated second to the left of Suhani.

**Hence, the correct answer is 'option 2'.**
